1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a __thermally conductive binder that is a premixed solder paste__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and forms boiling nucleation sites on the surface__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __by heating to a temperature sufficient to vaporize the solvent without melting the binder__.
